💻 Build Smarter Shipping - Join eAWB as Our First In-House Developer
 Do you love building products people actually use? 
 At eAWB.ro, we’re making parcel shipping faster, simpler and smarter – and we’re looking for a Senior Full-Stack Developer to own our platform end to end.
 You’ll be our first in-house developer: you make the technical calls, ship features used by thousands of customers every day, and shape the tech team as it grows. We’re a startup, so priorities shift fast – and we build with AI every day. If you see AI as part of how great developers work today, this role is for you.
 ✅ What You’ll Do 
Build features across the backend (Laravel) and frontend (React / Vue)
Build and improve integrations with couriers and online stores
Write clean, tested code, using AI tools daily
Own the database, deployments and servers, and keep the platform fast and secure
Make the technical calls and, as the team grows, help hire and lead new developers
Work with sales, operations, customer care and marketing to solve real problems
 🧩 What We’re Looking For 
5+ years as a full-stack developer, with React or Vue
Deep Laravel knowledge, including running apps in production – our entire backend runs on it
Experience with REST APIs and relational databases (PostgreSQL or MySQL)
You use AI tools daily (Claude Code, Cursor or similar) and own what they produce
You move fast when priorities change, without losing quality
Good English (written and spoken)
 🚀 What We Offer 
Remote-first role – presence at the office is needed just 2–4 times per month
Unlimited-term contract (no fixed end date)
Competitive salary with performance-based bonuses
Meal tickets (meal card) and private health insurance
Access to the latest AI tools
Real impact – your code reaches more than 80,000 customers
A small, friendly team and the chance to shape our tech team from day one
 About eAWB 
 eAWB is a Romanian courier marketplace that makes shipping easier for individuals, marketplace sellers and small businesses. We compare courier prices instantly, offer real-time tracking, easy returns and full API integration for online stores. With over 80,000 customers, we’re redefining how Romania ships – one smart delivery at a time.
 📦 Ready to build the tech behind how Europe ships? 
 Apply now and help us shape eAWB from the ground up.
